description: Open-source alternative to Claude Duet: a self-hosted autonomous AI agent that runs tasks end to end — tools, approvals, routines, background tasks, MCP, Telegram. Desktop (Electron) + Android (Capacitor) + web PWA. Claude or any OpenAI-compatible model (Ollama, LM Studio, OpenRouter). MIT. Not affiliated with Anthropic.
